say:1:1331017001:1.text: Don't worry, it won't an issue for attending.
say:1:1331017001:1.source_cn: 不用担心，这并不会成为参加化妆舞会的阻碍。
say:1:1331017001:1.male: Don't worry, it won't an issue for attending.
say:1:1331017001:1.female: Don't worry, it won't an issue for attending.

say:2:1331017002:1.text: We've already anticipated this and have hired professional makeup artists to assist everyone.
say:2:1331017002:1.source_cn: 我们镇上早就考虑到这个问题，镇子里为大家配备有专业的化妆师。
say:2:1331017002:1.male: We've already anticipated this and have hired professional makeup artists to assist everyone.
say:2:1331017002:1.female: We've already anticipated this and have hired professional makeup artists to assist everyone.

say:3:1331017003:1.text: They can do many different looks. Just pick the one you like!
say:3:1331017003:1.source_cn: 化妆师那里准备了不少套妆容，你们只需选出自己的喜欢的类...
say:3:1331017003:1.male: They can do many different looks. Just pick the one you like!
say:3:1331017003:1.female: They can do many different looks. Just pick the one you like!
